place: Choeng Mon, Plai Laem, Bo Phut, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani 84320, Thailand
title: Five-Bedroom Sea-View Villa above Choeng Mon with 16-Metre Infinity Pool and Wellness Level
blurb: A newly completed hillside villa with one of the widest views on the north-east coast — a 16-metre saltwater infinity pool, four master suites plus a fifth flexible room, and a dedicated wellness level with gym, sauna and ice bath. Sold fully furnished on a 738 m² plot above Choeng Mon.
detail:
Set high on the hillside above Choeng Mon, in one of the most sought-after pockets of Koh Samui, this newly completed villa looks out across a sweep of turquoise bays, offshore islands and the green headlands of the north coast. It is the kind of outlook that rarely comes to market, and the house has been designed to make the most of it from almost every room.

The main level opens onto a broad terrace and a 16-metre saltwater infinity pool that runs the full width of the view. A sunken lounge sits at the water’s edge, with an outdoor kitchen, grill and bar beside it and a strip of lawn for children or a quiet afternoon. Inside, the living room is generous and calm — pale stone floors, a deep modular sofa, large-format artwork — and the kitchen and dining areas flow straight out to the deck.

Four master suites each have floor-to-ceiling glass facing the sea and their own bathrooms finished in grey marble with walk-in showers. A fifth room, currently set up with a pool table and its own bathroom, can easily become another bedroom. A full lower level is given over to wellness: a properly equipped gym looking out over the hillside, a timber sauna and an ice bath — a rare combination in a private home.

The villa is sold fully furnished with a curated interior package, and is connected to mains electricity with its own deep well. Parking sits on the same level as the house, so there are no long stairs from the car — practical day to day, and unusual on a hillside of this calibre. Chaweng’s restaurants, beach clubs and shops are a few minutes’ drive away, with the quieter beaches of Choeng Mon, Bang Rak and Bophut close by.

Approximately 466 m² of interior space and around 670 m² of total living area including terraces, on a 738 m² freehold plot held through a company. The villa is being offered privately and is not listed publicly; viewings and full details are shared on request.
